name: dumbbell devils press
description: A full body move: burpee onto dumbbells, then swing them overhead. It builds power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Squat and place the dumbbells on the floor, then step or jump your feet back.
Do a push up if you like.
Jump your feet forward and stand up, swinging the dumbbells overhead.
Keep your back flat and move with rhythm.
